build_single_field_transform: build a SingleFieldTransform to apply a torchvision transform to a specific field of a Sample
create_vision_transform: create a VisionTransform to apply image transformations to the vision field of a Sample
test_list_transform: test the ListTransform class to apply a transform across all items in a list
refactor_flatten_list_of_list: refactor the FlattenListOfList class to flatten nested lists of samples into a single list
review_masking_transform: review the MaskingTransform class to create masks for VisionSample inputs for MAE training
